correctness.rationale: The source corollary yields exactly E_r+2=B_r\{0,1}. The top ternary set has no nonconstant triple. For r>=2 the two blocks have maximum L=(3^r+1)/2, giving exactly four cross-block triples and one quadruple, with no five-term crossing; the elementary inequalities are explicitly given in RESULT.md. Step-by-step recurrences with base B_1={0,...,5} and the deletion of 0,1 produce every formula. Seven terms would yield three equally spaced top-digit Stanley elements. The standalone checker independently tested the membership predicate on 130 Motzkin values and all step spectra at r=1..8; 189 grouped assertions passed. Finite tests are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Nondivisible Motzkin indices form a natural sparse base-three sequence. The underlying Stanley set is 3-AP-free, yet its threefold thickening creates long progressions. The theorem identifies the sharp global transition to length six, proves every allowed step and its exact multiplicity at every scale, and shows that the total number of triples is only linear in the eligible set size (rather than supplying a routine congruence table). The cross-block four-triple/one-quadruple rigidity is the structural reason and is directly reusable for related digit thickenings.
